prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Vikram Y., Vikram bhai, Subhash bhai, Manoj bhai.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 7:15 pm and 8:27 pm: 7 messages
- between 8:27 pm and 9:15 pm: 14 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "7:18 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Vikram bhai chai peene chalein shaam ko?"},
  {"time": "7:25 pm", "sender": "Vikram bhai", "text": "Haan bilkul, thoda kaam khatam karke nikalta hoon."},
  {"time": "7:32 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Mujhe bhi bata dena jab niklo tum log."},
  {"time": "7:45 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Main abhi bazar taraf hi hoon, wahin milte hain."},
  {"time": "7:55 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, purani dukaan par hi ikattha hote hain."},
  {"time": "8:10 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Waise wo pichhli baar ka hisab dekh liya kya sabne?"},
  {"time": "8:20 pm", "sender": "Vikram bhai", "text": "Haan sab dekh liya hai, milte hi baat karte hain."},
  {"time": "8:29 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Main dukaan ke paas pahunch gaya hoon."},
  {"time": "8:33 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Bas thodi der mein aata hoon, rasta jaam hai."},
  {"time": "8:38 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Vikram bhai aap kahan tak pahunche?"},
  {"time": "8:42 pm", "sender": "Vikram bhai", "text": "Bus pahunch hi raha hoon, gaadi park kar raha hoon."},
  {"time": "8:46 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Aaram se aao, koi jaldi nahi hai."},
  {"time": "8:50 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Mausam kaafi accha ho gaya hai waise."},
  {"time": "8:54 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Haan thandak ho gayi hai thodi."},
  {"time": "8:58 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Chai ka order de do tab tak."},
  {"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "Vikram bhai", "text": "Main aa gaya, samne hi khada hoon."},
  {"time": "9:05 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, baithte hain andar."},
  {"time": "9:08 pm", "sender": "Subhash bhai", "text": "Wo purana baaki hisab samajh lenge aaj."},
  {"time": "9:11 pm", "sender": "Vikram Y.", "text": "Haan bilkul, sab aapas mein dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "9:13 pm", "sender": "Vikram bhai", "text": "Chalo pehle garam chai peete hain."},
  {"time": "9:15 pm", "sender": "Manoj bhai", "text": "Haan bhai chalte hain andar."}
]
